exact_statement: Let f be a Boolean function on n bits, N > n, x0 in {-1,1}^N, p = 2^(-N), and g_N(x) = f(x_1..x_n)(1 - 2*1{x = x0}). (a) ghat_N(S) = fhat(S)*1{S subset [n]} - 2p f(x0) chi_S(x0) for every S subset [N]; for every A subset [N] the coefficient of g_N*chi_A at [N] is nonzero, so d_{g_N chi_A}(S) = N for every S and every anchor A, and U(g_N) = N Var(g_N) - I(g_N). (b) |I_i(g_N) - I_i(f)| <= 2p for every i, so |I(g_N) - I(f)| <= 2Np. (c) the spectral laws satisfy ||p(g_N) - p(f)||_1 <= 4p(2^(n/2) + 1), and |H(g_N) - H(f)| <= eps N + h2(eps) with eps = 2p(2^(n/2) + 1). (d) for nonconstant f, H(g_N) -> H(f), I(g_N) -> I(f) and U(g_N)/I(g_N) -> infinity. (e) if psi(s,N) >= 0 with max_s psi(s,N) = o(2^N) and Psi(g) = sum over nonempty S with ghat(S) != 0 of ghat(S)^2 psi(|S|, d_g(S)), then Psi(g_N) - sum_{S nonempty} fhat(S)^2 psi(|S|, N) -> 0; hence an inequality H <= alpha I + beta Var + Psi valid for all Boolean functions implies H(f) <= alpha I(f) + beta Var(f) + liminf_N sum_{S nonempty} fhat(S)^2 psi(|S|, N) for all Boolean f. (f) FEI with constant C on the class {g_N} implies FEI with constant C for all Boolean functions.
hypotheses: uniform measure on the Boolean cube; Boolean outputs in {-1,1}
entropy in bits; p_S = fhat(S)^2; I = sum |S| p_S; Var = 1 - p_empty
d_g(S) = max{|T| : T contains S, ghat(T) != 0}; U(g) = sum over nonempty S with p_S > 0 of p_S (d_g(S) - |S|)
N > n; f fixed while N -> infinity in (c)-(f)
